title: Reverse the Word Order
statement: A notice board message was typed backwards word by word. Given one line of words separated by single or multiple spaces, print the words in reverse order separated by single spaces.
input_format: One line containing at least one word. Words contain only English letters.
output_format: Print the words in reverse order, separated by single spaces.
constraints: The line has at most 100000 characters.

examples.explanation: The last word comes first: nine at starts exam.

hints: Split the line into words first; ignore extra spaces.
Once you have a list of words, walk it from the end to the start.
Join the words with exactly one space and print the result.
